ModHeader.Author: StamperDoesMods
ModHeader.Description:
Art of War vastly expands the weapon material system of Fallout 4 with dozens of new cosmetic options. Designed with an emphasis on lore and locational viability, this mod allows you to explore a wasteland full of fresh-faced firearms, and build a personalized arsenal that stands out more than ever before!

This is the CRAFT ONLY version of the mod, built for compatibility, and contains no vanilla edits.
